purpose: The one ledger the release gate reads (scripts/sim/audit/release-ready.mjs). An item is here because a named audit finding is not closed: either it is open (it must name the condition that closes it), it was handed to a taskbook lane, or it is accepted for a deployment reason. Fixed items stay as evidence with the code/test that closed them. Nothing is written here without a file:line or a command that reproduces it.
rules: P0 open => NOT READY. P1 open is allowed only with an owner and a named condition; P2 is bookkeeping.
An entry is not an exemption from a test: suites still have to pass, this ledger only answers the question a suite cannot (who still owes what).
Fixed entries are kept on purpose so the same finding is not discovered again as new.

items.title: the release gate can be satisfied by a hand-typed report: it recognises a shape, not a provenance
items.evidence: scripts/sim/audit/release-ready.mjs:81-91 recognises an audit report by three regexes plus five section headings; a 12-line hand-typed file ('AUDIT: PASS — 0 failure(s), 0 warning(s)', the five headings, 'compared: 12; gaps: 0') yields exit 0 / ready=true / reasons=[]; a report whose own body says placeholder and 'compared: 0' is still READY. Three defects: no provenance, 'compared: 0' is read as zero gaps, and a conclusion line overrides the body. The override reason is printed (:23/:295) but never enters the facts, and the report's P0 list is never parsed (ledger open P0 = 0). | CLOSED: the gate no longer reads the report, it re-measures it. Every number in AUDIT.md is demoted to a claim and cross-checked against five facts the gate derives itself: the current code tree hash, the single current-corpus layer named by the writer pointer D:/_tmp/sim/current-layer.json, the bytes+sha256 of every receipts.jsonl inside that layer, the corpusId derived from those files, and the auditId derived from corpusId|treeHash, plus the fidelity triple recomputed from the receipts. Disagreement is refused by name: AUDIT_TREE_CHANGED / AUDIT_CORPUS_UNMEASURED / AUDIT_CORPUS_STALE / AUDIT_CORPUS_NOT_CURRENT / AUDIT_ID_MISMATCH / AUDIT_FIDELITY_MISMATCH. Final red team on clean tree 15417e55 (gate a5b901c9, sentinel e3b0c442, three reads identical, non-VOID): 23 vectors = 21 named + 2 neutralized (A6-blank: an empty override value is dropped by flagValue, so it can neither be recorded nor cleared; A8b: forging is re-measuring, no payoff), masked/half/leaked/error all 0, run-all exit 0 and after-run exit 0. Three vectors are now inexpressible in the model: A10 / A10:extra (the gate no longer picks a layer), A11 (no file list = AUDIT_CORPUS_UNMEASURED), A16b (a same-bytes copy in another directory = AUDIT_CORPUS_NOT_CURRENT; the directory is the identity).
